execution_boundary: Preserved-score calculations and evidence consolidation only; no generation, inference, folding or screening
primary_population: The existing conditional14-candidate review panel; do not reinstate the six exact-exclusivity failures
extrapolation_sensitivity: Compare existing compatible pools with their subsets whose preserved Ridge value is within0..100 inclusive. This is a numerical sensitivity stratum, NOT a validated biological exclusion rule.
baseline_statistics: Reuse verified prior rank_correlations.csv and topK_overlap.csv
new_statistics: top-K exact and fractional boundary-tie overlap
small_pool_rule: K>n is NOT_APPLICABLE; K=n overlap is explicitly non-discriminating
exact_K_tie_rule: score descending then literal candidate_id ascending
fractional_ties: Split remaining boundary membership equally across tied candidates; preserve both exact and fractional overlap
missing_output_sensitivity: Describe actual coverage; compare the five common potency methods on100 versus the81 with preserved native Bench scores. No imputation, new ensemble, missing-score assignment or simulated missingness.
combined_priority: Preserve the existing20-cohort-normalized combined score even on restrictions; no normalization or weight changes
inference: Descriptive rankings only. No p-values, invented CIs, accuracy estimates or biological changes inferred from cohort-dependent ranks.
source_preservation: Content-hash every source file before and after; verify prior output manifest and receipt
